lead.headline: The 21-point lead is gone; Daniels needs 36
lead.deck: 77.9 to 114.04 with only Daniels left. ESPN: 3%.
lead.body: Bad news first: Tuten, your FLEX, played hurt and went down again in the fourth quarter for 8.3 (Yahoo), while Rice scored 11.3 on the bench. Likely had 4.5 and Taylor 6.7 on Thursday. KEI returns finished at 114.04 behind Jonah Coleman's 34.9. Daniels plays Cincinnati tonight and needs 36.2; his best game this season is 29.8. Jacobs' return turns on Tuesday's report before Wednesday's Rams game, and Marks is still in protocol. Taylor gets Anthony Richardson Sr. at quarterback from Week 12.

doFirst.empty: Nothing to decide this morning: Daniels starts, and every other slot is final.
